stories.headline: Fifth Canadian soldier dies from injuries caused by large fire at military base
stories.summary: Pte William Douglas Dal Bianco died from his injuries on Friday, a month after a fire that tore through CFB Wainwright.

stories.now: Global News: A fifth Canadian soldier has died from injuries sustained during a training exercise last month at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta.
stories.backstory: On Oct. 17 a grass fire swept over soldiers training at CFB Wainwright, a large army training base in eastern Alberta, after the wind shifted. Four soldiers died at the time or soon after, among them Morgan Wong, 26, of Edmonton and Shaun Farrell, 23, of Prince Albert, Sask. Investigators have said they believe the fire began on an automatic grenade launcher range in a restricted zone that firefighters could not enter. Questions under review include whether training rules were adequate and why the grass fire was not treated as a threat in strong winds; the country's top general, Jennie Carignan, has said the findings will be made public. Prime Minister Mark Carney has called it one of the worst peacetime tragedies for the Armed Forces on Canadian soil.
